title: Sharing sweets fairly
subject: Mathematics
objective: Tell an odd number from an even one by sharing it out.

steps.text: Some numbers share out fairly between two friends. Some always leave one behind.
Six sweets. Three each. Nobody is left out.
Seven sweets. Three each, and one sweet nobody can have.
Six shares out fairly. Seven always leaves one behind.

ask.prompt: Tap the number that cannot be shared fairly.
ask.hint: The one that leaves a sweet over.
Can you give five to each friend?

steps.text: That is what odd and even means. Nothing to memorise.

faq.a: Zero is even. Share nothing between two friends and they still get the same: nothing each, with none left over.
Once you can see which numbers split in two, halving stops being a rule you memorise and becomes something you can check.
